mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_WISH ( WISH_NO, MEMBER_NO, PRODUCT_NO, CREATE_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_WISH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO, P.CONTENT_NO, P.ACTOR_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE, NVL(AED.ACTIVE_EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.DISCOUNT_RATE, 0)) AS DISCOUNT_RATE, NVL(P.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS, B.BUSINESS_NAME, PI.MAIN_IMAGE
FROM PRODUCT_WISH W
INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = W.PRODUCT_NO
INNER JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE W.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
ORDER BY W.CREATE_AT DESC
